name: Iyashi Banchou
source:
"You seem a little down huh. Are you worried about something?"
A Banchou who takes a counseling older brother position with maidens.
Just talking to him can heal your heart.
He's the younger brother of do-S Bancho and the older brother of Maiden Bancho.
